evidence_required: ≤ 150 words naming the data sources (commissioning baselines, vendor thresholds, failure history).

marking.criterion: Uses commissioning baselines per optic type and link class (distribution, not one value)
Uses vendor module thresholds and the KP4 limit as outer bounds
Refines with failure/RMA history (which trends preceded failures)
States a concrete rule (e.g. ≥ 1 decade below the FEC limit) and keeps `[ILLUSTRATIVE]` until validated

title: Setting real warning thresholds
